description: Figure 3, titled “Results of Ablation Study,” presents two grouped bar charts comparing the accuracy (%) of the proposed DAE model under five different ablation settings on the PHEME and PolitiFact datasets. The vertical axis represents Accuracy (%) ranging from 75.0 to 95.0 in increments of 2.5. The left chart, labeled “PHEME,” displays five bars: “Ours” (dark red, 89.84%), “w/o comments” (orange, 86.82%), “w/o text” (light blue, 80.10%), “w/o emotion” (medium blue, 87.34%), and “w/o cognition” (dark blue, 87.17%). The right chart, labeled “PolitiFact,” similarly shows five bars: “Ours” (dark red, 90.57%), “w/o comments” (orange, 85.85%), “w/o text” (light blue, 83.02%), “w/o emotion” (medium blue, 84.91%), and “w/o cognition” (dark blue, 87.74%). In both charts, the “Ours” bar is the tallest, indicating the full model achieves the highest accuracy. Removing text input causes the largest performance drop in both datasets, followed by removing comments. The removal of emotion and cognition components results in smaller, but still significant, accuracy reductions, with emotion having a greater impact than cognition on PolitiFact. The bars are grouped by dataset, with each group containing five bars corresponding to the ablation variants, and all bars are labeled with their exact accuracy values.
